title: Help
intro: Armadok deploys Docker Compose projects, publishes them with Traefik and shows how everything is connected. This page explains the words and the first steps.
start.title: First steps
start.step1: Open Nodes and add the node you want to manage (or use this one if it is listed).
start.step2: Give it a worker: a small program, run on that node, that does the work on request. The Worker tab gives you the exact command.
start.step3: Open Projects to deploy a Compose project, or Traefik to publish a site with HTTPS.
start.step4: Open the Map tab of a node to see what is connected to what.
words.title: The words
words.node.name: Node
words.node.text: A server Armadok manages. Each node has an owner, members and its own rights.
words.worker.name: Worker
words.worker.text: The small program on a node. It connects out to Armadok and only runs a fixed list of operations in allowed folders.
words.project.name: Project
words.project.text: A Docker Compose folder on a node: its compose file, its settings and its containers.
words.site.name: Site
words.site.text: A Traefik router: a domain name that leads to a service, usually with a certificate.
words.middleware.name: Middleware
words.middleware.text: A step a request goes through before reaching a site: a password, headers, a redirect, a limit.
words.relation.name: Relations
words.relation.text: The links between objects: a container, its project, the router that serves it, the domain that points to it.
words.note.name: Note
words.note.text: A private memo attached to any object. Only you read it, unless you choose to show it to someone.
rights.title: Rights
rights.text: Everything you can do depends on rights, given per node, domain, project or container. If you cannot see something, it does not exist for you; if you can see it but not act, the screen says a right is missing. Nobody can give more than they hold.
rights.sensitive: Some rights are sensitive: they change who can reach what, or move data out. They are never given to API keys, and the actions behind them ask for a fresh second-factor code.
safety.title: Privacy and safety
safety.text: Secrets are encrypted and never shown again. Notes are private. Administrators have no hidden access to your nodes: emergency access exists, needs a reason and a second factor, and warns the owner. Every action is written to the audit log.
shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.text: Press Ctrl+K (or ⌘K) to search nodes, containers, projects, sites, domains and your notes, and to jump to any page.
